title: Neumann 1992 lumbar ALL tensile modulus from crosshead strain

quantity.name: tensile modulus (crosshead)
quantity.definition: E_MSH: linear-region slope of stress vs crosshead strain (crosshead displacement / motion-segment height)

source.authors: Neumann P, Keller TS, Ekstrom L, Perry L, Hansson TH, Spengler DM
source.n: 6 bone-ALL-bone preparations from 3 male cadavers (21, 29, 43 y)
source.sample: human lumbar ALL (T12-L1 to L4-L5), young donors, normal discs

protocol.summary: Bone-ALL-bone preparations (disc and PLL dissected away, ALL intact); vertebrae pinned with 4 Steinmann pins each; no mechanical preconditioning; distraction to failure at constant crosshead rate 2.5 mm/s (~1.07 %/s overall ligament strain rate); 12 video markers on ALL; tissue irrigated with 0.9% saline. Stress = load / ligament substance area (LA); overall strain from outermost marker pairs (e1-4); moduli = slope of linear region (LZ) of stress-strain.
how_to_simulate: Build a bone-ALL-bone model (disc and PLL removed) with ALL CSA ~38 mm2 and motion-segment height ~77 mm
Distract the vertebrae axially at 2.5 mm/s until ALL failure
Report failure load, crosshead deformation at failure, failure stress (load/area) and overall strain/modulus from the central ligament region

extraction.check_notes: Only mean, SD and range reported. doi not printed.

pass_rule.rule: |model - mean| <= 1 SD (or inside [min, max] when no SD)
